privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: F1 Replay uses analytics and consent tooling to understand site usage and improve reliability. This policy explains what data is processed at a high level.

collect.title: What We Collect
collect.body: We may process technical and usage data such as page views, browser and device metadata, referrer URLs, and interaction events. We do not intentionally collect sensitive personal data through analytics events.

cookies.title: Cookies and Consent
cookies.body: We use Cookiebot for consent management and Google tools for measurement. Non-essential storage and analytics are controlled by your consent preferences.

thirdParties.title: Third Parties
thirdParties.body: Data may be processed by third-party providers such as Google and Cookiebot in accordance with their terms and privacy policies.

privacyPage.disclaimer: This page is a general summary and not legal advice.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: By using F1 Replay, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please stop using the service.

use.title: Use of Service
use.body: You may use the app for lawful, personal, or internal business purposes. You agree not to abuse, disrupt, or reverse engineer the service in a way that harms its availability.

dataSources.title: Data Sources
dataSources.body: The platform displays motorsport data from third-party sources. Data may be delayed, incomplete, or inaccurate at times.

noWarranty.title: No Warranty
noWarranty.body: The service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without warranties of any kind.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, F1 Replay is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

termsPage.disclaimer: This page is a basic template and not legal advice.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.gettingStartedBody: Select a circuit and session (Free Practice, Qualifying, or Race) from the top navigation. The app will load real-time F1 data from the OpenF1 API.
howItWorks.playPauseBody: Toggle playback with the button or spacebar
howItWorks.scrubTimelineBody: Click or drag the playback bar to jump to any time
howItWorks.keyboardBody: Arrow keys frame-step, Space toggles play
howItWorks.telemetryMetricsBody: View high-frequency speed, throttle, brake, RPM, gear, DRS, and brake temperature data
howItWorks.multiDriverComparisonBody: Select one or more drivers to compare side-by-side telemetry traces
howItWorks.tireDataBody: Monitor tire surface temperatures and compound wear progression during stints
howItWorks.focusedOverlayBody: Use the focused telemetry view for full-screen, high-resolution analysis
howItWorks.hoverDetailsBody: Inspect exact values at any point in time with precision tooltips
howItWorks.strategyTimelineBody: Visualize pit stops, tire compound changes, stint lengths, and tire age tracking
howItWorks.tireCompoundsBody: Color-coded compound visualization (soft, medium, hard, intermediate, wet) for all stints
howItWorks.pitAnalysisBody: Exact pit timings and strategy call sequences per driver
howItWorks.overtakesTabBody: Complete list of overtakes with tactical context
howItWorks.liveTimingBody: Current position, gaps, intervals, pit status, and active in-pit tags
howItWorks.teamRadioBody: Driver communications synced to playback, with direct in-toast audio playback when recordings are available
howItWorks.raceControlBody: Flags, SC/VSC, incidents, and official messages
howItWorks.circuitLayoutBody: Visual track map with turn names, DRS zones, and sector divisions
howItWorks.sectorPerformanceBody: Real-time sector times and speed trap data for comparison
howItWorks.driverFocusBody: Click a driver in timing or on-map to focus the camera and follow that car around the circuit
howItWorks.driverHeatmapBody: Focus mode can overlay lap-based speed heatmap colors on the track map for quick pace reads
howItWorks.circuitDetailsBody: Track name, length, total lap count, and key characteristics when available
howItWorks.trackStatusBody: Live weather, flags, and track condition updates
howItWorks.leaderboardBody: Grid view of race standings with gaps and intervals
howItWorks.driverTrackerBody: Immersive replay with track map, tire strategy, telemetry, radio, and timing data with focused driver telemetry parity
howItWorks.commentaryBody: Event feeds (radio, race control, overtakes, weather)
howItWorks.finalResultsBody: Open the Final Classification dialog with podium cards and complete race result table after sessions finish
howItWorks.underTheHoodTitle: 🧠 How It Works Under The Hood
howItWorks.sharedTimelineBody: A single session clock drives map, timing, telemetry, toasts, and event feeds.
howItWorks.smartCachingBody: API responses are persisted with TanStack Query, so switching tabs and revisiting sessions stays fast.
howItWorks.derivedEventLayersBody: Timeline helpers transform raw API rows into markers, toasts, chapters, and track-state overlays.
howItWorks.mapInterpolationBody: Car positions are interpolated at the current playhead time, then rendered on SVG geometry for smooth replay motion.
howItWorks.liveSettingsBody: Overlay and notification toggles update the UI immediately without reloading session data.
howItWorks.notificationsBody: Enable/disable event toasts (radio, flags, overtakes, pits, fastest laps)
howItWorks.trackMapBody: Show/hide focused HUD, leaderboard, tyre badges, battle rings, sector flags, and heatmap overlays
howItWorks.playbackSpeedBody: Set default speed and enable speed controls
howItWorks.resilienceBody: Friendly error pages handle route and runtime failures without breaking the app shell
howItWorks.tipBodyPrefix: All data is from the public
howItWorks.feedbackPrefix: Found a bug or have feedback?
howItWorks.author: Author
howItWorks.supportBody: Enjoying the project? Support development with a slice.
